title: Vite dev/preview proxy makes every proxied client look like loopback while public quick-tunnel hosts are allowlisted by default
test: tests/viteConfig.test.js: 'the dev and preview servers do not allow quick-tunnel hosts by default', 'only the value true opts in to the quick-tunnel host', 'SHARE_BASE_URL and EXTRA_ALLOWED_ORIGINS hosts are still allowed without the opt-in', 'both proxy entries of the dev and preview servers forward the client address with xfwd' (also passing before the fix, as guards: 'VITE_ALLOW_QUICK_TUNNEL=true adds the quick-tunnel host to the dev and preview servers', 'the opt-in adds the quick-tunnel host next to the configured hosts')
proof: On the unchanged vite.config.mjs, 4 of the 6 new tests failed: with no flag server.allowedHosts and preview.allowedHosts were ['.trycloudflare.com'] instead of []; with VITE_ALLOW_QUICK_TUNNEL=false the host was still allowed (assertion "server, flag "false"" failed: the host was in the list); with only SHARE_BASE_URL/EXTRA_ALLOWED_ORIGINS set the list still began with '.trycloudflare.com'; and neither proxy entry (/api, /socket.io) on server or preview had xfwd (expected true, actual undefined). After the fix all 6 pass. vite.config.mjs now starts allowedHosts empty and adds '.trycloudflare.com' only when String(env.VITE_ALLOW_QUICK_TUNNEL || '').toLowerCase() === 'true'; both proxy entries set xfwd: true; the config comments document the opt-in, the risk and that the backend uses the forwarded headers only when it trusts them (TRUST_X_FORWARDED_HEADERS, TRUST_PROXY). The test calls the exported config function from an empty working directory, with VITE_ALLOW_QUICK_TUNNEL, SHARE_BASE_URL, EXTRA_ALLOWED_ORIGINS and LOCAL_HTTPS set explicitly (empty string beats a developer's .env, since loadEnv is called with an empty prefix) and restores them afterwards. Failing output of the unchanged code is in the lane scratchpad file watch-TASK-105-before.txt. A real proxied request through a running Vite server was not made (the config hardcodes backend port 3000); xfwd is the http-proxy option that adds X-Forwarded-For/-Proto/-Host/-Port, and `vite build` with the new config loads without error.
